content.comment_body: Hello, I am attempting to connect a mobile app (using the trial button initially) to control one output. All connections appear correct, as I can view the module from both my laptop and mobile device, but the trial button on the mobile app will not activate output Q. Does anyone know what settings should be applied to the mobile button (tag, edit tag, value, etc.), as well as the correct configuration for output Q1 and input I1 using [product_name]? Should I be using NI1 or NQ1? Also, although I have previously connected to [product_name] multiple times, I am now receiving an 'Error SSL Handshaking Failed' message. Thank you.
Closed because this question was posted twice. The second thread, titled 'Can't see [product_name] from app,' is available in the discussion section for [product_name]. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user is trying to control an output remotely via a mobile app for [product_name], but is having trouble configuring output activation within the app. Furthermore, the user receives an 'Error SSL Handshaking Failed' notification during some connection attempts, indicating possible issues with security protocol configuration. Uncertainty regarding using settings like NI1 or NQ1 highlights a need for clearer instructions on linking app controls to hardware I/O.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects an easy-to-follow configuration process to control the outputs of [product_name] using a mobile app, along with a secure and successful connection between the app and the module.
